highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.3 updates Skia m156 with safer GPU allocations and corrected image filtering and glyph rendering.
highlights_body: The native servicing update leaves managed APIs and the native C ABI unchanged.

bullets.detail: Prevents Ganesh image filters from sampling unwritten scratch-texture texels through mipmaps and clips destination reads to their intended bounds. Graphite also resets depth tracking after overwriting draws to preserve painter order.
Corrects LCD16 bitmap bounds and cropping when successive glyph loads return different outlines, avoiding misaligned copies and assertions. Outline translation is also checked for overflow.
Rejects overflowing or invalid Ganesh buffer sizes and skips draws when allocation fails instead of proceeding with an invalid buffer.
